name: Helen Stevenson Meyner
desc: United States Representative from New Jersey (1929-1997)
summary: Helen Day Stevenson Meyner (March 5, 1929 — November 2, 1997) was an American politician from New Jersey. A Democrat, Meyner served as a U.S. representative from New Jersey from 1975 to 1979. As the wife of New Jersey Governor Robert B. Meyner, she was First Lady of New Jersey from 1957 to 1962.
